name: Consolidated Grunenfelder Saady Holding Company
summary: Consolidated Grunenfelder Saady Holding Company manufactures and sells cooling containers for food transport vehicles, non-refrigerated bodies for the vehicles, and unportable cold storage rooms in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company provides industrial and commercial refrigeration products, temperature-controlled logistic solutions, insulated sandwich panels, and mobile cold stores. It also offers telecom, offshore and land containers, mobile workshop, mobile clinics and ambulance conversions, defense, prefabricated electrical enclosure, and customized solutions.
